title: Switching traces for DNF formulas
statement: Let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ coordinates, let $\rho$ assign each coordinate one of the states free, fixed at $1$, or fixed at $-1$, and let $k\in\mathbb{N}$. A switching trace of index $k+1$ is either specified by a compatible term chosen canonically from $\varphi$ under $\rho$ and a set of $k+1$ of its free literal positions, or specified by a compatible canonical term under $\rho$, an index $i<k$, and a vector $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$ such that the term has exactly $i+1$ free literal positions and becomes incompatible after the coordinates at all those positions are fixed according to $x$; in the latter case the trace also includes a switching trace of index $k-i$ under the resulting coordinate restriction.
hypotheses_covered: A DNF formula on n coordinates
A coordinate restriction assigning each coordinate free, fixed at 1, or fixed at -1
The trace index is k+1 for k a natural number
In the final constructor, at least one term is compatible with the restriction
In the final constructor, the selected positions are among the canonical term's free literal positions
The selected positions have cardinality k+1
In the recursive constructor, at least one term is compatible with the original restriction
The recursive index i is a natural number less than k
The recursive constructor includes a vector x in F₂ⁿ
The canonical term has exactly i+1 free literal positions
The canonical term is incompatible after all its free-literal coordinates are fixed according to x
The recursive constructor includes a tail trace of index k-i under the updated restriction
